fc-sh-2473.example: Factories must reduce the pollutants they release into the river.
fc-sh-2473.exampleZh: 工廠必須減少排入河流的污染物。
fc-sh-2473.memoryTip: pollute 污染 + ant 表示東西：造成污染的東西

fc-sh-2491.example: The game continued regardless of the heavy rain.
fc-sh-2491.exampleZh: 不管雨下得多大，比賽還是繼續進行。
fc-sh-2491.memoryTip: regard 看重 + less 不：不看重那件事，所以不管它

fc-sh-2485.example: Heat radiates from the old stove and warms the whole room.
fc-sh-2485.exampleZh: 熱氣從老爐子散發出來，讓整個房間都暖了。
fc-sh-2485.memoryTip: radi 是光線，和 radio 同源：像光線一樣向四周散開

fc-sh-2394.example: The teacher designated Amy as the team leader.
fc-sh-2394.exampleZh: 老師指定 Amy 擔任組長。
fc-sh-2394.memoryTip: de + sign 記號：做上記號，指定就是你

fc-sh-2570.example: In ancient races, each chariot was pulled by fast horses.
fc-sh-2570.exampleZh: 在古代賽事中，每輛戰車都由快馬拉動。
fc-sh-2570.memoryTip: char 和 car 同源：古代的 car，就是馬拉的戰車

fc-sh-2461.example: Plants take in nutrients from the soil through their roots.
fc-sh-2461.exampleZh: 植物透過根部從土壤吸收養分。
fc-sh-2461.memoryTip: nutri 滋養，和 nutrition 同家族：滋養身體的東西

fc-sh-2524.memoryTip: thrift 節儉，二手店叫 thrift shop：省錢買好物

fc-sh-2961.example: This television has a liquid crystal display, or LCD screen.
fc-sh-2961.exampleZh: 這台電視使用液晶顯示器，也就是 LCD 螢幕。
fc-sh-2961.collocation: liquid crystal display screen (液晶顯示螢幕)

fc-jh-1355.example: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
fc-jh-1355.exampleZh: 根據氣象報告，明天會下雨。
fc-jh-1355.collocation: according to the news (根據新聞)

fc-sh-1991.example: Please wring the wet towel before you hang it up.
fc-sh-1991.exampleZh: 把濕毛巾掛起來之前，請先擰乾。

fc-sh-2627.example: Don't fling your bag on the floor when you get home.
fc-sh-2627.exampleZh: 回到家時，別把書包隨手往地上一扔。
